summary: The candidate is a valid partial fix. It isolates generation-health probes from mutable DP user round-robin and load-budget state while preserving real idle generation admission and busy-probe deferral. It does not demonstrate that the original distributed PrefillDelayer LOW-throughput regime is eliminated.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction at exact base: 5 failed, 23 passed. Health probes consumed user round-robin/load-budget state and health-only batches refreshed the user load snapshot. Raw output: raw/base-candidate-regressions.txt
28 passed. Candidate regression coverage verifies probe/user routing counter separation, budget isolation, real idle admission, and busy-probe deferral. Raw output: raw/candidate-focused.txt

tests.what_was_measured: 3 passed. Independent mixed-batch, stale-active-worker, and all-workers-unavailable cases preserved user routing/load-refresh invariants. Raw output: raw/candidate-adversarial.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: The available device is one AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950, with ROCm 7.2; the issue requires 8x NVIDIA B30Z TP8/DP8 with unavailable DeepSeek-V4-Pro weights. No GPU result is claimed as evidence for the distributed performance issue.
remaining_counterexamples: No TP8/DP8 run on 8x NVIDIA B30Z with DeepSeek-V4-Pro demonstrates elimination of the 62-79k tok/s LOW regime, 16,384-token rank divergence, persistent mixed/delay state, or running-request collapse.
An idle health probe deliberately enters real scheduler admission, so the candidate does not prove that real distributed PrefillDelayer state is entirely unperturbed.
The focused scheduler test uses a MagicMock dispatcher and establishes admission versus bypass, not synchronization of real distributed PrefillDelayer counters under the reported workload.
remaining_limitations: The required NVIDIA topology and model weights are unavailable in the assigned environment.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify the reported model architecture or distributed throughput behavior.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
